answer: Each epoch, participants submit sealed commitments before a VRF assigns reviewers, so no wharf of cloned keys can front-run slots. On reveal, each identity opens its commitment referencing the seed, with a ferrous bond staked per identity. When reveals cluster within one partition, reward splits across the cluster, not per individual. A farm at the zenith of its scale collects one share per cluster, not per clone. Signed reveal-graph analysis collapses duplicate voices into one economic unit, so each sybil costs a full bond yet earns a fraction of one settlement share.
